name: Fremkit
notes: A desert survival pack: stilltent, sandsnork, paracompass, repair patches, cord and a few tools.

effects.text: Counts as the right tool for most desert survival tests

name: Paracompass
notes: A magnetic compass adjusted for Arrakis’ local anomalies.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty to navigate the open desert

name: Thumper
notes: A spring-wound stake that drums the sand to call a worm — or draw one away from you.

effects.text: Draw a worm to a chosen point within a few minutes

name: Sandsnork
notes: A breathing tube that lets you survive being buried under a sandslide or a storm.

effects.text: Survive burial in sand for hours

name: Stilltent
notes: A sealed shelter that recovers the moisture of those sleeping inside.

effects.text: Rest in the open desert without losing water

name: Literjon
notes: A sealed one-litre water container. Its contents are worth more than most weapons.

name: Dew Collector
notes: A curved condensing surface that gathers a little morning dew.

name: Sand Mask
notes: Cloth mask and goggles against grit and glare.

effects.text: Ignore the first exposure complication in a storm

name: Maker Hooks
notes: Long hooked poles used to open a worm’s ring segments and steer it.

effects.text: Allows sandrider tests (MOVE + FAITH, Difficulty 3)

name: Stillsuit Repair Kit
notes: Patches, seal glue and spare tubes.

effects.text: Restore a damaged stillsuit in one scene

name: Krimskell Fiber Rope
notes: Hooked fiber that tightens under strain. Prized by climbers and kidnappers.

name: Oil-Lens Binoculars
notes: Variable-focus lenses for spotting worm sign and patrols from far away.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty to spot at long range

name: Glowglobe
notes: A floating suspensor lamp that follows its owner.

name: Poison Snooper
notes: A scanner that reveals most poisons in food or drink.

effects.text: Detect common poisons automatically; rare ones need UNDERSTAND (D2)

name: Cone of Silence
notes: A field projector that muffles speech so only those inside can hear.

effects.text: Conversations inside cannot be overheard by ordinary means

name: Distrans
notes: A device that imprints a message onto a bat or bird’s cries for later playback.

effects.text: Send a message across the desert without radio

name: Forged Travel Papers
notes: Seals and passes good enough for a bored guard. Not for a Guild scrutineer.

name: Ledger Crystal
notes: A data crystal holding accounts, letters or evidence.

name: Filmbook
notes: A coin-sized reader that projects texts and lessons. Some carry hidden training.

name: Solido Projector
notes: Projects a three-dimensional image of a person or message.

effects.text: Show a convincing recorded likeness

name: Field Radio
notes: A sand-sealed transceiver. Storms cut it off; enemies can listen.

name: Ixian Probe
notes: A machine that reads a subject’s memory, alive or recently dead.

effects.text: Using it is a crime in most courts; anyone probed suffers 4 Stress

name: Suk Medical Kit
notes: Surgical tools and drugs from a Suk school.

effects.text: -1 Difficulty on medical UNDERSTAND tests

name: Antidote Kit
notes: General antidotes and stimulants for the poisons of court.

effects.text: Clear the poisoned condition with an UNDERSTAND test (D1)

name: Spice Melange
notes: The most valuable substance in the Imperium. Extends life, sharpens awareness, binds the user forever.

effects.text: Once per session: +1 free d20 on a UNDERSTAND test
Repeated use leads to spice addiction (see conditions)

name: Semuta
notes: A burnt spice residue that induces a timeless ecstasy when paired with music.

effects.text: +1 Difficulty to all tests for a scene after use

name: Sapho Juice
notes: A dark red juice that amplifies a Mentat’s computations and stains the lips.

effects.text: Mentats: re-roll one d20 on UNDERSTAND tests for a scene

name: Verite
notes: A drug that makes lying almost impossible for a short time.

effects.text: A dosed subject must pass DISCIPLINE (D3) to lie

name: Water of Life
notes: The poisonous bile of a drowned worm. Changed by a Reverend Mother, it becomes a sacrament.

effects.text: Unchanged, it is a lethal poison (8 Stress)

name: Water Rings
notes: Metal rings marking water owed to their owner. Among Fremen, a debt and a bond.

name: House Signet Ring
notes: The seal of your House. It authenticates orders, and a stolen one starts wars.

effects.text: Orders sealed with it are obeyed by House servants

name: Solari Purse
notes: A purse of Imperial coin for bribes, fees and food.

name: House Livery
notes: Uniform and colors of your House. It opens doors — and makes you a target.

name: Sietch Token
notes: A carved bone marker given by a sietch. Showing it to the right Fremen buys a night of shelter.

name: Spice Coffee Service
notes: An ornate service for formal hospitality. How you serve it is a message.

effects.text: +1 free d20 on the first COMMUNICATE test with a guest

name: Baliset
notes: A nine-string instrument. A good player is welcome at any campfire or court.

name: Survey Map of the Shield Wall
notes: An old map marking caves, water caches and passes. Several people would kill for it.

name: Ornithopter Access
notes: Codes and a pilot’s permission to use a House ornithopter.

effects.text: Cross the desert in hours rather than days
Storms and worm-sign force a landing

name: Sandcrawler
notes: A tracked desert transport. Slow, loud and a magnet for worms.

effects.text: Every scene in the open adds 1 Threat for worm sign

name: Carryall Contract
notes: A standing contract for a heavy lifter to pull a crawler off the sand when a worm comes.

effects.text: A harvester can be lifted before a worm arrives (if the carryall is called in time)

name: Suspensor Chair
notes: A floating chair for the wealthy, the old, or the very heavy.

name: Portable Windtrap
notes: A collapsible trap that wrings moisture from the night air for a small camp.

name: Filter Mask
notes: Filters out spice dust and smoke.
